a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan of building to 8 first almost guarantees we both end at 0. The reserve can only save one of us right now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1 instead of waiting. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that and won't take anything more, so you can reach 4 too. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you directly rather than hiding it. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you.
